description: PostgreSQL 18 timestamptz precision, UTC storage, session rendering, named zones, DST, arithmetic, conversion, indexing, and validation
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_timestamptz (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TIMESTAMPTZ(3) UNIQUE);
SELECT id, value FROM type_matrix_timestamptz ORDER BY value, id;

SELECT '2024-02-29 12:34:56.5555555-05'::timestamptz AS rounded, '2024-02-29 23:59:59.9999995+00'::timestamptz AS carry, 'epoch'::timestamptz AS epoch, 'infinity'::timestamptz AS pos_inf, '-infinity'::timestamptz AS neg_inf;
SELECT '2024-02-29 12:00:00 America/Los_Angeles'::timestamptz AS named, '2024-02-29 12:00:00 UTC'::timestamptz AS utc_named, '2024-02-29 12:00:00+05:30'::timestamptz AS explicit_offset;

SELECT '2024-03-09 12:00:00'::timestamptz + interval '1 day' AS calendar_day, '2024-03-09 12:00:00'::timestamptz + interval '24 hours' AS absolute_day, '2024-11-03 01:30:00'::timestamptz - '2024-11-03 00:30:00'::timestamptz AS difference;
SELECT '2024-11-03 01:30:00'::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS to_instant, '2024-11-03 01:30:00-05'::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS to_local;

SELECT extract(epoch from '2000-01-02 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz) AS epoch, date_part('epoch', '2000-01-02 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz) AS date_part_epoch, date_trunc('day', '2024-03-10 12:34:56+00'::timestamptz) AS local_day;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_timestamptz WHERE value = '2024-11-03 06:30:00+00'::timestamptz;
SELECT id, value FROM type_matrix_timestamptz WHERE id IN ('rounded', 'fold') ORDER BY id;
